record.title: Orlivka–Isaccea ferry admission suspended after attack, October 2023
record.endpoint_type: reopening of passage; ordinary timetable normalization not established
record.scope: Orlivka–Isaccea international Danube river ferry checkpoint only
record.direction: Both directions at the named ferry checkpoint
record.movement: People and vehicle traffic using this ferry crossing; whole Romania–Ukraine frontier was not closed.
record.imposing_authority: Ukrainian border authorities; Romanian Coast Guard operated the corresponding Isaccea suspension
record.enforcement: Border crossing operations suspended; ferries anchored on the Romanian bank.
record.consequences: Traffic diverted to other crossing routes.
record.relationship: Separate September and October episodes; never combine across the September 26 reopening.
record.status_observation: Historical episode; evidence dates only. No inference about status at observation cutoff.
record.official_rationale: Suspension following an attack on the Ukrainian checkpoint area, pending safe operation.
record.context: Russian strike on Ukrainian border infrastructure according to Ukrainian official account. A local Romanian mayor attributed deliberate checkpoint targeting; intent is not independently established here.
record.uncertainty: October 15 is reopening of admission, not proof of a fully restored timetable. November 1 local report describes earlier daytime restart and expanded service while loosely saying closed since September; preserved as conflicting/condensed continuity evidence.

historical.endpoint: reopening of passage; ordinary timetable normalization not established
historical.duration_note: Withheld pending continuity and endpoint-scope adjudication
